admission_deadlines_dates_valid.name: admission_deadlines_dates_valid
admission_deadlines_dates_valid.value: "admission_deadlines"."deadline" >= "admission_deadlines"."opens_on" and ("admission_deadlines"."decision_on" is null or "admission_deadlines"."decision_on">="admission_deadlines"."deadline") and ("admission_deadlines"."enrollment_deadline" is null or "admission_deadlines"."enrollment_deadline">="admission_deadlines"."deadline")

announcements_expiry_valid.name: announcements_expiry_valid
announcements_expiry_valid.value: "announcements"."expires_at" is null or "announcements"."published_at" is null or "announcements"."expires_at">"announcements"."published_at"

fee_structures_amounts_valid.name: fee_structures_amounts_valid
fee_structures_amounts_valid.value: ("fee_structures"."tuition" is null or "fee_structures"."tuition">=0) and ("fee_structures"."registration_fee" is null or "fee_structures"."registration_fee">=0) and "fee_structures"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'

scholarships_dates_order.name: scholarships_dates_order
scholarships_dates_order.value: "scholarships"."deadline" is null or "scholarships"."opens_on" is null or "scholarships"."deadline">="scholarships"."opens_on"

submission_content.name: submission_content
submission_content.value: ("assignment_submissions"."content" is not null) <> ("assignment_submissions"."storage_key" is not null)

grade_points_valid.name: grade_points_valid
grade_points_valid.value: ("grade_scale"."points" is null or "grade_scale"."points">=0) and (not "grade_scale"."counts_for_gpa" or "grade_scale"."points" is not null)

semester_dates.name: semester_dates
semester_dates.value: "semesters"."ends_on">="semesters"."starts_on" and ("semesters"."registration_ends_at" is null or "semesters"."registration_ends_at">="semesters"."registration_starts_at") and ("semesters"."exam_ends_on" is null or "semesters"."exam_ends_on">="semesters"."exam_starts_on")

exam_result_marks.name: exam_result_marks
exam_result_marks.value: ("exam_results"."marks" is null or "exam_results"."marks">=0) and ("exam_results"."draft_marks" is null or "exam_results"."draft_marks">=0)
